description: This file contains functions related to platform upgrade and image checking for embedded devices running OpenWRT on Rockchip ARMv8 hardware. It performs tasks such as verifying partition layouts, copying configurations, and performing upgrades by manipulating disk and partition images.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the integrity and consistency of the disk image and partition layout before upgrade.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the target partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process by comparing partition layouts, writing images to disks/partitions, and updating UUIDs.
